This architecture will be implemented later by a seeded local code model and evaluated automatically. Produce concrete design and implementation tasks for every file; do not use placeholders.

Normative evaluator protocol (these paths are mandatory and override preferences):
- build file: pom.xml
- runtime entry: src/main/java/Main.java
- single test target: src/test/java/MainTest.java
- test command: mvn -q test
- keep exactly one protocol-level test file; additional non-test implementation files are allowed

Language/layout constraints:
Use Maven and Java 11 without preview features. Main.java must be in the default package because the evaluator runs Main. Put every other project class directly under src/main/java and keep it in the default package too; do not create package subdirectories or package declarations. This deliberately avoids package/import mismatches in independently generated files. Keep core logic independent from Swing/JavaFX; prefer no GUI and no non-test external dependency. pom.xml MUST declare org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter with test scope and a Maven Surefire version that runs JUnit 5; MainTest.java must use JUnit Jupiter only. Repeat this exact dependency contract in the pom.xml task.


Project-specific Java 11 press-release type-ownership and deterministic-test contract:
- use exactly these files and no substitutes, in dependency order: pom.xml, src/main/java/ReleaseState.java, src/main/java/Version.java, src/main/java/Template.java, src/main/java/Validator.java, src/main/java/PressRelease.java, src/main/java/TaggingSystem.java, src/main/java/RenderService.java, src/main/java/Main.java, src/test/java/MainTest.java
- ReleaseState.java is the sole definition site for `public enum ReleaseState { DRAFT, REVIEW, PUBLISHED }`. Version.java is the sole definition site for ordinary Java 11 `public final class Version` with private final int number and private final String renderedText, constructor Version(int number,String renderedText), getters getNumber/getRenderedText, and value-based equals/hashCode/toString. ReleaseState and Version must never be omitted, nested in another class, or referenced without these definitions; Java record syntax and post-Java-11 syntax are forbidden
- Template.java defines `public final class Template`, constructor Template(String name,String content), getters getName/getContent, and `String applyCustomFields(Map<String,String> fields)`. Placeholders have literal form `{{key}}`; supplied keys are replaced by their values, missing placeholders remain unchanged, a null map acts as an empty map, and the Template is immutable
- Validator.java defines a stateless `public final class Validator` with exactly the static methods validateHeadline(String), validateBody(String), and validateContact(String). The first two accept non-null non-blank text; validateContact additionally requires one `@` with nonempty text on both sides. Validation returns false and never throws for null/invalid text
- PressRelease.java defines ordinary `public final class PressRelease` with constructor PressRelease(String id,String headline,String body,String contact,Template template,Map<String,String> customFields). It exposes getId/getHeadline/getBody/getContact/getState, validate(), submitForReview(), publish(), addTag(String), getTags(), renderPlainText(), and getVersionHistory(). It starts DRAFT; submitForReview requires validate()==true and DRAFT then changes to REVIEW; publish requires REVIEW then changes to PUBLISHED and appends exactly one `new Version(1, renderPlainText())` for the first publication. Collections are insertion-ordered defensive copies, invalid transitions throw IllegalStateException, and no clock, timestamp, randomness, filesystem, or network is used
- PressRelease.renderPlainText builds a new field map containing headline, body, and contact plus the constructor customFields and passes it to Template.applyCustomFields. TaggingSystem is stateless and defines `static List<PressRelease> searchByTag(List<PressRelease> releases,String tag)`, preserving input order and returning releases whose getTags contains the exact trimmed tag. RenderService is stateless and defines `static String toPlainText(PressRelease release)` delegating to release.renderPlainText; neither service owns ReleaseState or Version
- Main.java is a thin non-interactive Java 11 demo. MainTest.java uses JUnit Jupiter and contains exactly three `@Test` methods: (1) Main.main(new String[0]) returns normally; (2) Template("basic","{{headline}}|{{body}}|{{contact}}") substitution yields `Hello|Body|a@b.com` and Validator accepts those three values but rejects a blank headline and contact "invalid"; (3) construct release id "r1" with those values, assert DRAFT, submitForReview then assert REVIEW, add tag "media", publish then assert PUBLISHED, render exact `Hello|Body|a@b.com`, assert version history size 1 with Version number 1 and the same rendered text, and assert TaggingSystem.searchByTag(Arrays.asList(release),"media") returns only that release
- Full API specification, Logic Analysis, Test Scope Plan, Shared Knowledge, and every affected implementation task must repeat the exact 10-file list, sole ReleaseState/Version ownership, all canonical signatures, lifecycle rules, literal template/validation/lifecycle fixtures, exactly-three-test limit, and Java 11 restriction. Any architecture that references ReleaseState or Version without their two files is invalid

- about 8 repository files

- #Files, #Functions, and #LOC above are paper-table references, not acceptance bounds
- use the number of files produced by this architecture run; do not add or remove files merely to hit the reference

Required domain behavior:
- press-release templates
- custom fields and placeholder substitution
- draft review published lifecycle
- validation of headline body and contact
- audience tags and search
- plain-text rendering and version history

Cross-cutting requirements:
- separate pure domain logic from runtime, UI, filesystem, network, clock, and randomness boundaries
- automated tests must be deterministic, headless, offline, and require no manual interaction
- keep the single test target concise (2 to 4 tests, preferably under 150 LOC): cover runtime wiring and representative core rules, not the full feature matrix
- do not inflate the function/LOC target with test code; put substantive behavior in implementation files
- make every planned file small enough for one 4096-token code completion: prefer under 150 LOC and never plan a file over 220 LOC
- order the Task list strictly by implementation dependency: foundational types and interfaces first, then dependent implementations, then the runtime entry, and the single test target LAST (the build descriptor may be first)
- the Engineer code_todos must preserve that dependency-first Task-list order so later files can see already-generated dependency code
- the runtime entry must provide a small non-interactive demonstration that exits successfully or starts safely without an output loop
- validate invalid inputs and boundary cases
- keep public interfaces coherent across design, task list, implementation, and tests
- specify one canonical public API; tests must use it without inventing alternate semantics
- make Full API spec non-empty and exhaustive: for every public type/function give its exact module, signature, return value, error behavior, and key semantics; repeat these exact contracts in each affected file task
- tests may import only the canonical public API and should assert stable externally visible behavior, not private implementation details, incidental formatting, or unplanned aliases
- avoid circular dependencies; explicitly give the allowed import/include direction and ensure every referenced symbol is defined before a dependent file is generated
- avoid network access and OS-specific behavior during build, tests, and runtime checks
- all planned source, header, build, and test files must be listed exactly and consistently in the design and task documents

Generate a complete medium-size Java 11 repository architecture for: Custom press releases.

This architecture will be implemented later by a seeded local code model and evaluated automatically. Produce concrete design and implementation tasks for every file; do not use placeholders.

Normative evaluator protocol (these paths are mandatory and override preferences):
- build file: pom.xml
- runtime entry: src/main/java/Main.java
- single test target: src/test/java/MainTest.java
- test command: mvn -q test
- keep exactly one protocol-level test file; additional non-test implementation files are allowed

Language/layout constraints:
Use Maven and Java 11 without preview features. Main.java must be in the default package because the evaluator runs Main. Put every other project class directly under src/main/java and keep it in the default package too; do not create package subdirectories or package declarations. This deliberately avoids package/import mismatches in independently generated files. Keep core logic independent from Swing/JavaFX; prefer no GUI and no non-test external dependency. pom.xml MUST declare org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter with test scope and a Maven Surefire version that runs JUnit 5; MainTest.java must use JUnit Jupiter only. Repeat this exact dependency contract in the pom.xml task.


Project-specific Java 11 press-release type-ownership and deterministic-test contract:
- use exactly these files and no substitutes, in dependency order: pom.xml, src/main/java/ReleaseState.java, src/main/java/Version.java, src/main/java/Template.java, src/main/java/Validator.java, src/main/java/PressRelease.java, src/main/java/TaggingSystem.java, src/main/java/RenderService.java, src/main/java/Main.java, src/test/java/MainTest.java
- ReleaseState.java is the sole definition site for `public enum ReleaseState { DRAFT, REVIEW, PUBLISHED }`. Version.java is the sole definition site for ordinary Java 11 `public final class Version` with private final int number and private final String renderedText, constructor Version(int number,String renderedText), getters getNumber/getRenderedText, and value-based equals/hashCode/toString. ReleaseState and Version must never be omitted, nested in another class, or referenced without these definitions; Java record syntax and post-Java-11 syntax are forbidden
- Template.java defines `public final class Template`, constructor Template(String name,String content), getters getName/getContent, and `String applyCustomFields(Map<String,String> fields)`. Placeholders have literal form `{{key}}`; supplied keys are replaced by their values, missing placeholders remain unchanged, a null map acts as an empty map, and the Template is immutable
- Validator.java defines a stateless `public final class Validator` with exactly the static methods validateHeadline(String), validateBody(String), and validateContact(String). The first two accept non-null non-blank text; validateContact additionally requires one `@` with nonempty text on both sides. Validation returns false and never throws for null/invalid text
- PressRelease.java defines ordinary `public final class PressRelease` with constructor PressRelease(String id,String headline,String body,String contact,Template template,Map<String,String> customFields). It exposes getId/getHeadline/getBody/getContact/getState, validate(), submitForReview(), publish(), addTag(String), getTags(), renderPlainText(), and getVersionHistory(). It starts DRAFT; submitForReview requires validate()==true and DRAFT then changes to REVIEW; publish requires REVIEW then changes to PUBLISHED and appends exactly one `new Version(1, renderPlainText())` for the first publication. Collections are insertion-ordered defensive copies, invalid transitions throw IllegalStateException, and no clock, timestamp, randomness, filesystem, or network is used
- PressRelease.renderPlainText builds a new field map containing headline, body, and contact plus the constructor customFields and passes it to Template.applyCustomFields. TaggingSystem is stateless and defines `static List<PressRelease> searchByTag(List<PressRelease> releases,String tag)`, preserving input order and returning releases whose getTags contains the exact trimmed tag. RenderService is stateless and defines `static String toPlainText(PressRelease release)` delegating to release.renderPlainText; neither service owns ReleaseState or Version
- Main.java is a thin non-interactive Java 11 demo. MainTest.java uses JUnit Jupiter and contains exactly three `@Test` methods: (1) Main.main(new String[0]) returns normally; (2) Template("basic","{{headline}}|{{body}}|{{contact}}") substitution yields `Hello|Body|a@b.com` and Validator accepts those three values but rejects a blank headline and contact "invalid"; (3) construct release id "r1" with those values, assert DRAFT, submitForReview then assert REVIEW, add tag "media", publish then assert PUBLISHED, render exact `Hello|Body|a@b.com`, assert version history size 1 with Version number 1 and the same rendered text, and assert TaggingSystem.searchByTag(Arrays.asList(release),"media") returns only that release
- Full API specification, Logic Analysis, Test Scope Plan, Shared Knowledge, and every affected implementation task must repeat the exact 10-file list, sole ReleaseState/Version ownership, all canonical signatures, lifecycle rules, literal template/validation/lifecycle fixtures, exactly-three-test limit, and Java 11 restriction. Any architecture that references ReleaseState or Version without their two files is invalid


Medium-size reference from MetaProjectDev (descriptive only; the architecture model's generated file count is authoritative):
- about 8 repository files
- about 31 functions or methods
- about 698 lines of code

Sizing guidance:
- #Files, #Functions, and #LOC above are paper-table references, not acceptance bounds
- use the number of files produced by this architecture run; do not add or remove files merely to hit the reference
- count build, runtime, test, package markers, headers, and implementation files when reporting the realized size

Required domain behavior:
- press-release templates
- custom fields and placeholder substitution
- draft review published lifecycle
- validation of headline body and contact
- audience tags and search
- plain-text rendering and version history

Cross-cutting requirements:
- separate pure domain logic from runtime, UI, filesystem, network, clock, and randomness boundaries
- automated tests must be deterministic, headless, offline, and require no manual interaction
- keep the single test target concise (2 to 4 tests, preferably under 150 LOC): cover runtime wiring and representative core rules, not the full feature matrix
- do not inflate the function/LOC target with test code; put substantive behavior in implementation files
- make every planned file small enough for one 4096-token code completion: prefer under 150 LOC and never plan a file over 220 LOC

- validate invalid inputs and boundary cases

- specify one canonical public API; tests must use it without inventing alternate semantics
- make Full API spec non-empty and exhaustive: for every public type/function give its exact module, signature, return value, error behavior, and key semantics; repeat these exact contracts in each affected file task
- tests may import only the canonical public API and should assert stable externally visible behavior, not private implementation details, incidental formatting, or unplanned aliases
- avoid circular dependencies; explicitly give the allowed import/include direction and ensure every referenced symbol is defined before a dependent file is generated
- avoid network access and OS-specific behavior during build, tests, and runtime checks
- all planned source, header, build, and test files must be listed exactly and consistently in the design and task documents

{"Implementation approach":"Bob (Architect) proposes a simple, deterministic Java 11 Maven project with exactly 10 files, in strict dependency order, implementing the Custom press releases domain. We preserve the protocol: build file pom.xml, runtime entry src/main/java/Main.java, and single test target src/test/java/MainTest.java executed by mvn -q test. We keep every class in the default package (no package declarations) to avoid import mismatches. We use only headless, offline, pure Java 11 logic: no GUI, no filesystem, no network, no clock, no randomness.

Core domain model:
- ReleaseState: sole enum owner of DRAFT, REVIEW, PUBLISHED.
- Version: sole value object owner; number and renderedText with value-based equality, hashCode, getters, toString.
- Template: immutable name+content with deterministic placeholder substitution: literal {{key}} replaced if key is provided in the given Map; missing placeholders remain; null map treated as empty.
- Validator: stateless static methods for headline/body/contact validation. Headline/body require non-null/non-blank. Contact requires exactly one '@' and non-empty local and domain parts.
- PressRelease: aggregate root owning id, headline, body, contact, template, customFields, tags, state, and version history. Starts DRAFT. submitForReview() requires validate()==true and state DRAFT; otherwise IllegalStateException. publish() requires REVIEW; on first publication append exactly one Version(1, renderPlainText()) and move to PUBLISHED. Exposes defensive copies in insertion order for tags and versions. renderPlainText() constructs a new field map of headline, body, contact plus constructor customFields, then delegates to Template.applyCustomFields.
- TaggingSystem: stateless searchByTag(List<PressRelease>, String) that returns releases whose tags contain the exact trimmed tag, preserving input order. Nulls are treated defensively: null list or null tag yields empty result.
- RenderService: stateless toPlainText(PressRelease) delegating to release.renderPlainText; no ownership of ReleaseState or Version.

Maven/JUnit setup: pom.xml declares Java 11 compilation, the org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter dependency with test scope (as mandated) plus api/engine artifacts for runtime, and Maven Surefire 3.x to run JUnit 5. Tests are concise and deterministic.

Concrete implementation tasks by file (dependency-first order):
1) pom.xml: Set groupId/artifactId/version; configure maven-compiler-plugin for Java 11; add org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter with test scope; add junit-jupiter-api and junit-jupiter-engine; configure surefire 3.1.2 to enable JUnit 5.
2) src/main/java/ReleaseState.java: Define exactly public enum ReleaseState { DRAFT, REVIEW, PUBLISHED } as the sole owner.
3) src/main/java/Version.java: Define public final class Version with private final int number; private final String renderedText; public constructor Version(int,String); getters getNumber/getRenderedText; implement equals/hashCode/toString value-based.
4) src/main/java/Template.java: Define public final class Template(name,content) immutable; getters; applyCustomFields(Map<String,String>): if fields is null treat as empty; replace literal {{key}} with provided value (null values treated as empty string), others unchanged; no side effects.
5) src/main/java/Validator.java: Define public final class Validator with exactly static boolean validateHeadline(String), validateBody(String), validateContact(String). Headline/body: non-null and not blank. Contact: non-null, contains exactly one '@', with non-empty trimmed local and domain parts.
6) src/main/java/PressRelease.java: Define public final class PressRelease with constructor PressRelease(String id,String headline,String body,String contact,Template template,Map<String,String> customFields). Internal state: ReleaseState, insertion-ordered LinkedHashSet<String> tags, insertion-ordered List<Version> versionHistory, LinkedHashMap<String,String> customFields copy. Expose getters getId/getHeadline/getBody/getContact/getState; boolean validate(); void submitForReview(); void publish(); void addTag(String) (ignore null/blank; store trimmed; preserve insertion order; avoid duplicates); List<String> getTags() returns defensive copy in insertion order; String renderPlainText(); List<Version> getVersionHistory() returns defensive copy in order. Enforce invalid state transitions with IllegalStateException. On first publish (from REVIEW), append exactly new Version(1, renderPlainText()) and move to PUBLISHED.
7) src/main/java/TaggingSystem.java: Stateless utility with static List<PressRelease> searchByTag(List<PressRelease>, String) that returns a new list preserving input order and matching exact trimmed tag against each release.getTags(). Contains no state.
8) src/main/java/RenderService.java: Stateless utility with static String toPlainText(PressRelease) delegating to release.renderPlainText().
9) src/main/java/Main.java: Thin non-interactive demo that constructs a Template and a PressRelease, exercises validate/submitForReview/publish/render, prints one or two lines, and exits normally.
10) src/test/java/MainTest.java: Exactly three JUnit 5 tests: (1) Main.main(new String[0]) returns normally; (2) Template("basic","{{headline}}|{{body}}|{{contact}}") with fields for headline/body/contact yields Hello|Body|a@b.com; Validator accepts those and rejects blank headline and contact "invalid"; (3) Lifecycle test for release id "r1": assert initial DRAFT; submitForReview then REVIEW; add tag "media"; publish then PUBLISHED; render exact Hello|Body|a@b.com; assert version history size==1 with Version number==1 and same text; assert TaggingSystem.searchByTag(Arrays.asList(release),"media") returns only that release.

All methods return false for invalid inputs and never throw.

- public final class PressRelease
  - private final String id, headline, body, contact;
  - private final Template template;
  - private final java.util.LinkedHashMap<String,String> customFields; (defensive copy)
  - private ReleaseState state; (initially DRAFT)

  - public PressRelease(String id, String headline, String body, String contact, Template template, java.util.Map<String,String> customFields)
  - public String getId()
  - public String getHeadline()
  - public String getBody()
  - public String getContact()
  - public ReleaseState getState()
  - public boolean validate()
  - public void submitForReview()
  - public void publish()
  - public void addTag(String tag)
  - public java.util.List<String> getTags()
  - public String renderPlainText()
  - public java.util.List<Version> getVersionHistory()
- Semantics:
  - Construction: stores provided values; copies customFields into an insertion-ordered LinkedHashMap (null map treated as empty); initializes state to DRAFT; tags empty; versionHistory empty.
  - validate(): returns Validator.validateHeadline(headline) && Validator.validateBody(body) && Validator.validateContact(contact). No side effects.
  - submitForReview(): Requires current state == DRAFT and validate() == true. On success, state transitions to REVIEW. Otherwise throws IllegalStateException.
  - publish(): Requires current state == REVIEW. On success, appends exactly one new Version(1, renderPlainText()) to versionHistory if this is the first publication (i.e., versionHistory is empty) and sets state to PUBLISHED. Any call when not in REVIEW throws IllegalStateException. No randomness/clock involved.
  - addTag(String tag): Ignores null or blank input. Stores trimmed tag. Maintains insertion order and uniqueness (no duplicate entries). No exception for duplicates; duplicates are ignored.

Delegates to template.applyCustomFields(map) and returns result. No mutation of internal collections.
  - getVersionHistory(): Returns a defensive copy (java.util.ArrayList) of versions preserving insertion order.
  - Error behavior: submitForReview()/publish() throw IllegalStateException on invalid transitions; other methods avoid throwing for invalid data, except standard NPE if required constructor arguments (like template) are null and dereferenced later by caller; tests rely only on specified behavior.

{"Implementation approach":"Bob (Architect) proposes a simple, deterministic Java 11 Maven project with exactly 10 files, in strict dependency order, implementing the Custom press releases domain. We preserve the protocol: build file pom.xml, runtime entry src/main/java/Main.java, and single test target src/test/java/MainTest.java executed by mvn -q test. We keep every class in the default package (no package declarations) to avoid import mismatches. We use only headless, offline, pure Java 11 logic: no GUI, no filesystem, no network, no clock, no randomness.

Core domain model:
- ReleaseState: sole enum owner of DRAFT, REVIEW, PUBLISHED.
- Version: sole value object owner; number and renderedText with value-based equality, hashCode, getters, toString.
- Template: immutable name+content with deterministic placeholder substitution: literal {{key}} replaced if key is provided in the given Map; missing placeholders remain; null map treated as empty.
- Validator: stateless static methods for headline/body/contact validation. Headline/body require non-null/non-blank. Contact requires exactly one '@' and non-empty local and domain parts.
- PressRelease: aggregate root owning id, headline, body, contact, template, customFields, tags, state, and version history. Starts DRAFT. submitForReview() requires validate()==true and state DRAFT; otherwise IllegalStateException. publish() requires REVIEW; on first publication append exactly one Version(1, renderPlainText()) and move to PUBLISHED. Exposes defensive copies in insertion order for tags and versions. renderPlainText() constructs a new field map of headline, body, contact plus constructor customFields, then delegates to Template.applyCustomFields.
- TaggingSystem: stateless searchByTag(List<PressRelease>, String) that returns releases whose tags contain the exact trimmed tag, preserving input order. Nulls are treated defensively: null list or null tag yields empty result.
- RenderService: stateless toPlainText(PressRelease) delegating to release.renderPlainText; no ownership of ReleaseState or Version.

Maven/JUnit setup: pom.xml declares Java 11 compilation, the org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter dependency with test scope (as mandated) plus api/engine artifacts for runtime, and Maven Surefire 3.x to run JUnit 5. Tests are concise and deterministic.

5) src/main/java/Validator.java: Define public final class Validator with exactly static boolean validateHeadline(String), validateBody(String), validateContact(String). Headline/body: non-null and not blank. Contact: non-null, contains exactly one '@', with non-empty trimmed local and domain parts.
6) src/main/java/PressRelease.java: Define public final class PressRelease with constructor PressRelease(String id,String headline,String body,String contact,Template template,Map<String,String> customFields). Internal state: ReleaseState, insertion-ordered LinkedHashSet<String> tags, insertion-ordered List<Version> versionHistory, LinkedHashMap<String,String> customFields copy. Expose getters getId/getHeadline/getBody/getContact/getState; boolean validate(); void submitForReview(); void publish(); void addTag(String) (ignore null/blank; store trimmed; preserve insertion order; avoid duplicates); List<String> getTags() returns defensive copy in insertion order; String renderPlainText(); List<Version> getVersionHistory() returns defensive copy in order. Enforce invalid state transitions with IllegalStateException. On first publish (from REVIEW), append exactly new Version(1, renderPlainText()) and move to PUBLISHED.
7) src/main/java/TaggingSystem.java: Stateless utility with static List<PressRelease> searchByTag(List<PressRelease>, String) that returns a new list preserving input order and matching exact trimmed tag against each release.getTags(). Contains no state.
8) src/main/java/RenderService.java: Stateless utility with static String toPlainText(PressRelease) delegating to release.renderPlainText().
9) src/main/java/Main.java: Thin non-interactive demo that constructs a Template and a PressRelease, exercises validate/submitForReview/publish/render, prints one or two lines, and exits normally.
10) src/test/java/MainTest.java: Exactly three JUnit 5 tests: (1) Main.main(new String[0]) returns normally; (2) Template("basic","{{headline}}|{{body}}|{{contact}}") with fields for headline/body/contact yields Hello|Body|a@b.com; Validator accepts those and rejects blank headline and contact "invalid"; (3) Lifecycle test for release id "r1": assert initial DRAFT; submitForReview then REVIEW; add tag "media"; publish then PUBLISHED; render exact Hello|Body|a@b.com; assert version history size==1 with Version number==1 and same text; assert TaggingSystem.searchByTag(Arrays.asList(release),"media") returns only that release.

pom.xml:
- Declares Java 11 compilation via maven-compiler-plugin (source/target 11).
- Declares test-scoped org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter (5.x). Configures maven-surefire-plugin 3.1.2 to run JUnit 5.

src/main/java/ReleaseState.java:
- public enum ReleaseState { DRAFT, REVIEW, PUBLISHED }
- Sole definition site. Used by PressRelease to represent lifecycle state.

src/main/java/Version.java:
- public final class Version
  - private final int number;
  - private final String renderedText;
  - public Version(int number, String renderedText)
  - public int getNumber()
  - public String getRenderedText()
  - public boolean equals(Object o)
  - public int hashCode()
  - public String toString()
- Semantics: Value object with value-based equality by number and renderedText. Immutable; constructor stores given values without mutation; getters return stored values; toString returns a stable human-readable representation including both fields.

src/main/java/Template.java:
- public final class Template
  - private final String name;
  - private final String content;
  - public Template(String name, String content)
  - public String getName()
  - public String getContent()
  - public String applyCustomFields(java.util.Map<String, String> fields)
- Semantics: Immutable template with deterministic placeholder substitution. The literal placeholder form is {{key}}. applyCustomFields:
  - Treat null fields map as empty.
  - For each entry in fields, replace all literal occurrences of {{key}} in content with value (null values are treated as empty string "").
  - Missing placeholders remain unchanged. No side effects. Deterministic: same inputs produce same outputs.

src/main/java/Validator.java:
- public final class Validator
  - public static boolean validateHeadline(String text)
  - public static boolean validateBody(String text)
  - public static boolean validateContact(String text)
- Semantics: Stateless validation utilities. validateHeadline/validateBody return true iff text is non-null and contains at least one non-whitespace character (trim().isEmpty() == false). validateContact returns true iff text is non-null, contains exactly one '@', and both the local part (before '@') and domain part (after '@') are non-empty after trimming. All methods return false for invalid inputs and never throw.

src/main/java/PressRelease.java:
- public final class PressRelease
  - private final String id, headline, body, contact;
  - private final Template template;
  - private final java.util.LinkedHashMap<String,String> customFields; (defensive copy)
  - private ReleaseState state; (initially DRAFT)
  - private final java.util.LinkedHashSet<String> tags; (insertion ordered, trimmed, unique)
  - private final java.util.List<Version> versionHistory; (insertion ordered)
  - public PressRelease(String id, String headline, String body, String contact, Template template, java.util.Map<String,String> customFields)
  - public String getId()
  - public String getHeadline()
  - public String getBody()
  - public String getContact()
  - public ReleaseState getState()
  - public boolean validate()
  - public void submitForReview()
  - public void publish()
  - public void addTag(String tag)
  - public java.util.List<String> getTags()
  - public String renderPlainText()
  - public java.util.List<Version> getVersionHistory()
- Semantics:
  - Construction: stores provided values; copies customFields into an insertion-ordered LinkedHashMap (null map treated as empty); initializes state to DRAFT; tags empty; versionHistory empty.
  - validate(): returns Validator.validateHeadline(headline) && Validator.validateBody(body) && Validator.validateContact(contact). No side effects.
  - submitForReview(): Requires current state == DRAFT and validate() == true. On success, state transitions to REVIEW. Otherwise throws IllegalStateException.
  - publish(): Requires current state == REVIEW. On success, appends exactly one new Version(1, renderPlainText()) to versionHistory if this is the first publication (i.e., versionHistory is empty) and sets state to PUBLISHED. Any call when not in REVIEW throws IllegalStateException. No randomness/clock involved.
  - addTag(String tag): Ignores null or blank input. Stores trimmed tag. Maintains insertion order and uniqueness (no duplicate entries). No exception for duplicates; duplicates are ignored.
  - getTags(): Returns a defensive copy (java.util.ArrayList) of tags preserving insertion order.
  - renderPlainText(): Builds a new field map with keys "headline", "body", "contact" using the instance fields, then overlays/extends with constructor customFields (constructor fields take effect in addition to the three built-ins; if the map contains these keys, their values will be used by Template substitution rules). Delegates to template.applyCustomFields(map) and returns result. No mutation of internal collections.
  - getVersionHistory(): Returns a defensive copy (java.util.ArrayList) of versions preserving insertion order.
  - Error behavior: submitForReview()/publish() throw IllegalStateException on invalid transitions; other methods avoid throwing for invalid data, except standard NPE if required constructor arguments (like template) are null and dereferenced later by caller; tests rely only on specified behavior.

src/main/java/TaggingSystem.java:
- public final class TaggingSystem
  - public static java.util.List<PressRelease> searchByTag(java.util.List<PressRelease> releases, String tag)
- Semantics: Returns a new list preserving the input order of releases that contain the exact trimmed tag in their getTags() collection. If releases is null or tag is null, returns an empty list. The tag argument is trimmed before matching; matching is exact (case-sensitive). Stateless and deterministic.

src/main/java/RenderService.java:
- public final class RenderService
  - public static String toPlainText(PressRelease release)
- Semantics: Stateless delegator. Returns release.renderPlainText(). If release is null, throws NullPointerException due to dereference; tests do not require special null handling.

src/main/java/Main.java:
- public final class Main
  - public static void main(String[] args)
- Semantics: Thin, non-interactive demo that constructs a Template and a PressRelease with simple values, checks validate(), performs submitForReview() and publish(), renders plain text via RenderService.toPlainText(), prints one or two lines, and exits normally. No input, no loops, no network/filesystem/clock access.

src/test/java/MainTest.java:

src/main/java/ReleaseState.java:
- public enum ReleaseState { DRAFT, REVIEW, PUBLISHED }
- Sole definition site. Used by PressRelease to represent lifecycle state.

src/main/java/Version.java:
- public final class Version
  - private final int number;
  - private final String renderedText;
  - public Version(int number, String renderedText)
  - public int getNumber()
  - public String getRenderedText()
  - public boolean equals(Object o)
  - public int hashCode()
  - public String toString()
- Semantics: Value object with value-based equality by number and renderedText. Immutable; constructor stores given values without mutation; getters return stored values; toString returns a stable human-readable representation including both fields.

src/main/java/Template.java:
- public final class Template
  - private final String name;
  - private final String content;
  - public Template(String name, String content)
  - public String getName()
  - public String getContent()
  - public String applyCustomFields(java.util.Map<String, String> fields)
- Semantics: Immutable template with deterministic placeholder substitution. The literal placeholder form is {{key}}. applyCustomFields:
  - Treat null fields map as empty.
  - For each entry in fields, replace all literal occurrences of {{key}} in content with value (null values are treated as empty string "").
  - Missing placeholders remain unchanged. No side effects. Deterministic: same inputs produce same outputs.

src/main/java/Validator.java:
- public final class Validator
  - public static boolean validateHeadline(String text)
  - public static boolean validateBody(String text)
  - public static boolean validateContact(String text)
- Semantics: Stateless validation utilities. validateHeadline/validateBody return true iff text is non-null and contains at least one non-whitespace character (trim().isEmpty() == false). validateContact returns true iff text is non-null, contains exactly one '@', and both the local part (before '@') and domain part (after '@') are non-empty after trimming. All methods return false for invalid inputs and never throw.

src/main/java/PressRelease.java:
- public final class PressRelease
  - private final String id, headline, body, contact;
  - private final Template template;
  - private final java.util.LinkedHashMap<String,String> customFields; (defensive copy)
  - private ReleaseState state; (initially DRAFT)
  - private final java.util.LinkedHashSet<String> tags; (insertion ordered, trimmed, unique)
  - private final java.util.List<Version> versionHistory; (insertion ordered)
  - public PressRelease(String id, String headline, String body, String contact, Template template, java.util.Map<String,String> customFields)
  - public String getId()
  - public String getHeadline()
  - public String getBody()
  - public String getContact()
  - public ReleaseState getState()
  - public boolean validate()
  - public void submitForReview()
  - public void publish()
  - public void addTag(String tag)
  - public java.util.List<String> getTags()
  - public String renderPlainText()
  - public java.util.List<Version> getVersionHistory()
- Semantics:
  - Construction: stores provided values; copies customFields into an insertion-ordered LinkedHashMap (null map treated as empty); initializes state to DRAFT; tags empty; versionHistory empty.
  - validate(): returns Validator.validateHeadline(headline) && Validator.validateBody(body) && Validator.validateContact(contact). No side effects.
  - submitForReview(): Requires current state == DRAFT and validate() == true. On success, state transitions to REVIEW. Otherwise throws IllegalStateException.
  - publish(): Requires current state == REVIEW. On success, appends exactly one new Version(1, renderPlainText()) to versionHistory if this is the first publication (i.e., versionHistory is empty) and sets state to PUBLISHED. Any call when not in REVIEW throws IllegalStateException. No randomness/clock involved.
  - addTag(String tag): Ignores null or blank input. Stores trimmed tag. Maintains insertion order and uniqueness (no duplicate entries). No exception for duplicates; duplicates are ignored.
  - getTags(): Returns a defensive copy (java.util.ArrayList) of tags preserving insertion order.
  - renderPlainText(): Builds a new field map with keys "headline", "body", "contact" using the instance fields, then overlays/extends with constructor customFields (constructor fields take effect in addition to the three built-ins; if the map contains these keys, their values will be used by Template substitution rules). Delegates to template.applyCustomFields(map) and returns result. No mutation of internal collections.
  - getVersionHistory(): Returns a defensive copy (java.util.ArrayList) of versions preserving insertion order.
  - Error behavior: submitForReview()/publish() throw IllegalStateException on invalid transitions; other methods avoid throwing for invalid data, except standard NPE if required constructor arguments (like template) are null and dereferenced later by caller; tests rely only on specified behavior.

src/main/java/TaggingSystem.java:
- public final class TaggingSystem
  - public static java.util.List<PressRelease> searchByTag(java.util.List<PressRelease> releases, String tag)
- Semantics: Returns a new list preserving the input order of releases that contain the exact trimmed tag in their getTags() collection. If releases is null or tag is null, returns an empty list. The tag argument is trimmed before matching; matching is exact (case-sensitive). Stateless and deterministic.

src/main/java/RenderService.java:
- public final class RenderService
  - public static String toPlainText(PressRelease release)
- Semantics: Stateless delegator. Returns release.renderPlainText(). If release is null, throws NullPointerException due to dereference; tests do not require special null handling.

src/main/java/Main.java:
- public final class Main
  - public static void main(String[] args)
- Semantics: Thin, non-interactive demo that constructs a Template and a PressRelease with simple values, checks validate(), performs submitForReview() and publish(), renders plain text via RenderService.toPlainText(), prints one or two lines, and exits normally. We preserve the protocol: build file pom.xml, runtime entry src/main/java/Main.java, and single test target src/test/java/MainTest.java executed by mvn -q test. We keep every class in the default package (no package declarations) to avoid import mismatches. We use only headless, offline, pure Java 11 logic: no GUI, no filesystem, no network, no clock, no randomness.

Core domain model:
- ReleaseState: sole enum owner of DRAFT, REVIEW, PUBLISHED.
- Version: sole value object owner; number and renderedText with value-based equality, hashCode, getters, toString.
- Template: immutable name+content with deterministic placeholder substitution: literal {{key}} replaced if key is provided in the given Map; missing placeholders remain; null map treated as empty.
- Validator: stateless static methods for headline/body/contact validation. Headline/body require non-null/non-blank. Contact requires exactly one '@' and non-empty local and domain parts.
- PressRelease: aggregate root owning id, headline, body, contact, template, customFields, tags, state, and version history. Starts DRAFT. submitForReview() requires validate()==true and state DRAFT; otherwise IllegalStateException. publish() requires REVIEW; on first publication append exactly one Version(1, renderPlainText()) and move to PUBLISHED. Exposes defensive copies in insertion order for tags and versions. renderPlainText() constructs a new field map of headline, body, contact plus constructor customFields, then delegates to Template.applyCustomFields.
- TaggingSystem: stateless searchByTag(List<PressRelease>, String) that returns releases whose tags contain the exact trimmed tag, preserving input order. Nulls are treated defensively: null list or null tag yields empty result.
- RenderService: stateless toPlainText(PressRelease) delegating to release.renderPlainText; no ownership of ReleaseState or Version.

Maven/JUnit setup: pom.xml declares Java 11 compilation, the org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter dependency with test scope (as mandated) plus api/engine artifacts for runtime, and Maven Surefire 3.x to run JUnit 5. Tests are concise and deterministic.

1) pom.xml: Set groupId/artifactId/version; configure maven-compiler-plugin for Java 11; add org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter with test scope; add junit-jupiter-api and junit-jupiter-engine; configure surefire 3.1.2 to enable JUnit 5.

4) src/main/java/Template.java: Define public final class Template(name,content) immutable; getters; applyCustomFields(Map<String,String>): if fields is null treat as empty; replace literal {{key}} with provided value (null values treated as empty string), others unchanged; no side effects.
5) src/main/java/Validator.java: Define public final class Validator with exactly static boolean validateHeadline(String), validateBody(String), validateContact(String). Headline/body: non-null and not blank. Contact: non-null, contains exactly one '@', with non-empty trimmed local and domain parts.
6) src/main/java/PressRelease.java: Define public final class PressRelease with constructor PressRelease(String id,String headline,String body,String contact,Template template,Map<String,String> customFields). Internal state: ReleaseState, insertion-ordered LinkedHashSet<String> tags, insertion-ordered List<Version> versionHistory, LinkedHashMap<String,String> customFields copy. Expose getters getId/getHeadline/getBody/getContact/getState; boolean validate(); void submitForReview(); void publish(); void addTag(String) (ignore null/blank; store trimmed; preserve insertion order; avoid duplicates); List<String> getTags() returns defensive copy in insertion order; String renderPlainText(); List<Version> getVersionHistory() returns defensive copy in order. Enforce invalid state transitions with IllegalStateException. On first publish (from REVIEW), append exactly new Version(1, renderPlainText()) and move to PUBLISHED.
7) src/main/java/TaggingSystem.java: Stateless utility with static List<PressRelease> searchByTag(List<PressRelease>, String) that returns a new list preserving input order and matching exact trimmed tag against each release.getTags(). Contains no state.
8) src/main/java/RenderService.java: Stateless utility with static String toPlainText(PressRelease) delegating to release.renderPlainText().
9) src/main/java/Main.java: Thin non-interactive demo that constructs a Template and a PressRelease, exercises validate/submitForReview/publish/render, prints one or two lines, and exits normally.
10) src/test/java/MainTest.java: Exactly three JUnit 5 tests: (1) Main.main(new String[0]) returns normally; (2) Template("basic","{{headline}}|{{body}}|{{contact}}") with fields for headline/body/contact yields Hello|Body|a@b.com; Validator accepts those and rejects blank headline and contact "invalid"; (3) Lifecycle test for release id "r1": assert initial DRAFT; submitForReview then REVIEW; add tag "media"; publish then PUBLISHED; render exact Hello|Body|a@b.com; assert version history size==1 with Version number==1 and same text; assert TaggingSystem.searchByTag(Arrays.asList(release),"media") returns only that release.

Exposes defensive copies in insertion order for tags and versions. renderPlainText() constructs a new field map of headline, body, contact plus constructor customFields, then delegates to Template.applyCustomFields.

Generate a complete medium-size Java 11 repository architecture for: Custom press releases.

This architecture will be implemented later by a seeded local code model and evaluated automatically. Produce concrete design and implementation tasks for every file; do not use placeholders.

Normative evaluator protocol (these paths are mandatory and override preferences):

- runtime entry: src/main/java/Main.java
- single test target: src/test/java/MainTest.java
- test command: mvn -q test

Language/layout constraints:
Use Maven and Java 11 without preview features. Main.java must be in the default package because the evaluator runs Main. Put every other project class directly under src/main/java and keep it in the default package too; do not create package subdirectories or package declarations. This deliberately avoids package/import mismatches in independently generated files. Keep core logic independent from Swing/JavaFX; prefer no GUI and no non-test external dependency. pom.xml MUST declare org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter with test scope and a Maven Surefire version that runs JUnit 5; MainTest.java must use JUnit Jupiter only. Repeat this exact dependency contract in the pom.xml task.


Project-specific Java 11 press-release type-ownership and deterministic-test contract:
- use exactly these files and no substitutes, in dependency order: pom.xml, src/main/java/ReleaseState.java, src/main/java/Version.java, src/main/java/Template.java, src/main/java/Validator.java, src/main/java/PressRelease.java, src/main/java/TaggingSystem.java, src/main/java/RenderService.java, src/main/java/Main.java, src/test/java/MainTest.java
- ReleaseState.java is the sole definition site for `public enum ReleaseState { DRAFT, REVIEW, PUBLISHED }`. Version.java is the sole definition site for ordinary Java 11 `public final class Version` with private final int number and private final String renderedText, constructor Version(int number,String renderedText), getters getNumber/getRenderedText, and value-based equals/hashCode/toString. ReleaseState and Version must never be omitted, nested in another class, or referenced without these definitions; Java record syntax and post-Java-11 syntax are forbidden
- Template.java defines `public final class Template`, constructor Template(String name,String content), getters getName/getContent, and `String applyCustomFields(Map<String,String> fields)`. Placeholders have literal form `{{key}}`; supplied keys are replaced by their values, missing placeholders remain unchanged, a null map acts as an empty map, and the Template is immutable
- Validator.java defines a stateless `public final class Validator` with exactly the static methods validateHeadline(String), validateBody(String), and validateContact(String). The first two accept non-null non-blank text; validateContact additionally requires one `@` with nonempty text on both sides. Validation returns false and never throws for null/invalid text
- PressRelease.java defines ordinary `public final class PressRelease` with constructor PressRelease(String id,String headline,String body,String contact,Template template,Map<String,String> customFields). It exposes getId/getHeadline/getBody/getContact/getState, validate(), submitForReview(), publish(), addTag(String), getTags(), renderPlainText(), and getVersionHistory(). It starts DRAFT; submitForReview requires validate()==true and DRAFT then changes to REVIEW; publish requires REVIEW then changes to PUBLISHED and appends exactly one `new Version(1, renderPlainText())` for the first publication. Collections are insertion-ordered defensive copies, invalid transitions throw IllegalStateException, and no clock, timestamp, randomness, filesystem, or network is used

TaggingSystem is stateless and defines `static List<PressRelease> searchByTag(List<PressRelease> releases,String tag)`, preserving input order and returning releases whose getTags contains the exact trimmed tag. src/main/java/ReleaseState.java:
- public enum ReleaseState { DRAFT, REVIEW, PUBLISHED }
- Sole definition site. Used by PressRelease to represent lifecycle state.

src/main/java/Version.java:
- public final class Version
  - private final int number;
  - private final String renderedText;
  - public Version(int number, String renderedText)
  - public int getNumber()
  - public String getRenderedText()
  - public boolean equals(Object o)
  - public int hashCode()
  - public String toString()
- Semantics: Value object with value-based equality by number and renderedText. Immutable; constructor stores given values without mutation; getters return stored values; toString returns a stable human-readable representation including both fields.

src/main/java/Template.java:
- public final class Template
  - private final String name;
  - private final String content;
  - public Template(String name, String content)
  - public String getName()
  - public String getContent()
  - public String applyCustomFields(java.util.Map<String, String> fields)
- Semantics: Immutable template with deterministic placeholder substitution. The literal placeholder form is {{key}}. applyCustomFields:
  - Treat null fields map as empty.
  - For each entry in fields, replace all literal occurrences of {{key}} in content with value (null values are treated as empty string "").
  - Missing placeholders remain unchanged. No side effects. Deterministic: same inputs produce same outputs.

src/main/java/Validator.java:
- public final class Validator
  - public static boolean validateHeadline(String text)
  - public static boolean validateBody(String text)
  - public static boolean validateContact(String text)
- Semantics: Stateless validation utilities. validateHeadline/validateBody return true iff text is non-null and contains at least one non-whitespace character (trim().isEmpty() == false). validateContact returns true iff text is non-null, contains exactly one '@', and both the local part (before '@') and domain part (after '@') are non-empty after trimming. All methods return false for invalid inputs and never throw.

src/main/java/PressRelease.java:
- public final class PressRelease
  - private final String id, headline, body, contact;
  - private final Template template;
  - private final java.util.LinkedHashMap<String,String> customFields; (defensive copy)
  - private ReleaseState state; (initially DRAFT)
  - private final java.util.LinkedHashSet<String> tags; (insertion ordered, trimmed, unique)
  - private final java.util.List<Version> versionHistory; (insertion ordered)
  - public PressRelease(String id, String headline, String body, String contact, Template template, java.util.Map<String,String> customFields)
  - public String getId()
  - public String getHeadline()
  - public String getBody()
  - public String getContact()
  - public ReleaseState getState()
  - public boolean validate()
  - public void submitForReview()
  - public void publish()
  - public void addTag(String tag)
  - public java.util.List<String> getTags()
  - public String renderPlainText()
  - public java.util.List<Version> getVersionHistory()
- Semantics:
  - Construction: stores provided values; copies customFields into an insertion-ordered LinkedHashMap (null map treated as empty); initializes state to DRAFT; tags empty; versionHistory empty.
  - validate(): returns Validator.validateHeadline(headline) && Validator.validateBody(body) && Validator.validateContact(contact). No side effects.
  - submitForReview(): Requires current state == DRAFT and validate() == true. On success, state transitions to REVIEW. Otherwise throws IllegalStateException.
  - publish(): Requires current state == REVIEW. On success, appends exactly one new Version(1, renderPlainText()) to versionHistory if this is the first publication (i.e., versionHistory is empty) and sets state to PUBLISHED. Any call when not in REVIEW throws IllegalStateException. No randomness/clock involved.
  - addTag(String tag): Ignores null or blank input. Stores trimmed tag. Maintains insertion order and uniqueness (no duplicate entries). No exception for duplicates; duplicates are ignored.
  - getTags(): Returns a defensive copy (java.util.ArrayList) of tags preserving insertion order.
  - renderPlainText(): Builds a new field map with keys "headline", "body", "contact" using the instance fields, then overlays/extends with constructor customFields (constructor fields take effect in addition to the three built-ins; if the map contains these keys, their values will be used by Template substitution rules). Delegates to template.applyCustomFields(map) and returns result. No mutation of internal collections.
  - getVersionHistory(): Returns a defensive copy (java.util.ArrayList) of versions preserving insertion order.
  - Error behavior: submitForReview()/publish() throw IllegalStateException on invalid transitions; other methods avoid throwing for invalid data, except standard NPE if required constructor arguments (like template) are null and dereferenced later by caller; tests rely only on specified behavior.

src/main/java/TaggingSystem.java:
- public final class TaggingSystem
  - public static java.util.List<PressRelease> searchByTag(java.util.List<PressRelease> releases, String tag)
- Semantics: Returns a new list preserving the input order of releases that contain the exact trimmed tag in their getTags() collection. If releases is null or tag is null, returns an empty list. The tag argument is trimmed before matching; matching is exact (case-sensitive). Stateless and deterministic.

src/main/java/RenderService.java:
- public final class RenderService
  - public static String toPlainText(PressRelease release)
- Semantics: Stateless delegator. Returns release.renderPlainText(). If release is null, throws NullPointerException due to dereference; tests do not require special null handling.

src/main/java/Main.java:
- public final class Main

- Semantics: Thin, non-interactive demo that constructs a Template and a PressRelease with simple values, checks validate(), performs submitForReview() and publish(), renders plain text via RenderService.toPlainText(), prints one or two lines, and exits normally. We preserve the protocol: build file pom.xml, runtime entry src/main/java/Main.java, and single test target src/test/java/MainTest.java executed by mvn -q test. We keep every class in the default package (no package declarations) to avoid import mismatches. We use only headless, offline, pure Java 11 logic: no GUI, no filesystem, no network, no clock, no randomness.

Core domain model:
- ReleaseState: sole enum owner of DRAFT, REVIEW, PUBLISHED.
- Version: sole value object owner; number and renderedText with value-based equality, hashCode, getters, toString.
- Template: immutable name+content with deterministic placeholder substitution: literal {{key}} replaced if key is provided in the given Map; missing placeholders remain; null map treated as empty.
- Validator: stateless static methods for headline/body/contact validation. Headline/body require non-null/non-blank. Contact requires exactly one '@' and non-empty local and domain parts.
- PressRelease: aggregate root owning id, headline, body, contact, template, customFields, tags, state, and version history. Starts DRAFT. submitForReview() requires validate()==true and state DRAFT; otherwise IllegalStateException. publish() requires REVIEW; on first publication append exactly one Version(1, renderPlainText()) and move to PUBLISHED. Exposes defensive copies in insertion order for tags and versions. renderPlainText() constructs a new field map of headline, body, contact plus constructor customFields, then delegates to Template.applyCustomFields.
- TaggingSystem: stateless searchByTag(List<PressRelease>, String) that returns releases whose tags contain the exact trimmed tag, preserving input order. Nulls are treated defensively: null list or null tag yields empty result.
- RenderService: stateless toPlainText(PressRelease) delegating to release.renderPlainText; no ownership of ReleaseState or Version.

5) src/main/java/Validator.java: Define public final class Validator with exactly static boolean validateHeadline(String), validateBody(String), validateContact(String). Headline/body: non-null and not blank. Contact: non-null, contains exactly one '@', with non-empty trimmed local and domain parts.
6) src/main/java/PressRelease.java: Define public final class PressRelease with constructor PressRelease(String id,String headline,String body,String contact,Template template,Map<String,String> customFields). Internal state: ReleaseState, insertion-ordered LinkedHashSet<String> tags, insertion-ordered List<Version> versionHistory, LinkedHashMap<String,String> customFields copy. Expose getters getId/getHeadline/getBody/getContact/getState; boolean validate(); void submitForReview(); void publish(); void addTag(String) (ignore null/blank; store trimmed; preserve insertion order; avoid duplicates); List<String> getTags() returns defensive copy in insertion order; String renderPlainText(); List<Version> getVersionHistory() returns defensive copy in order. Enforce invalid state transitions with IllegalStateException. On first publish (from REVIEW), append exactly new Version(1, renderPlainText()) and move to PUBLISHED.
7) src/main/java/TaggingSystem.java: Stateless utility with static List<PressRelease> searchByTag(List<PressRelease>, String) that returns a new list preserving input order and matching exact trimmed tag against each release.getTags(). Contains no state.
8) src/main/java/RenderService.java: Stateless utility with static String toPlainText(PressRelease) delegating to release.renderPlainText().
9) src/main/java/Main.java: Thin non-interactive demo that constructs a Template and a PressRelease, exercises validate/submitForReview/publish/render, prints one or two lines, and exits normally.
10) src/test/java/MainTest.java: Exactly three JUnit 5 tests: (1) Main.main(new String[0]) returns normally; (2) Template("basic","{{headline}}|{{body}}|{{contact}}") with fields for headline/body/contact yields Hello|Body|a@b.com; Validator accepts those and rejects blank headline and contact "invalid"; (3) Lifecycle test for release id "r1": assert initial DRAFT; submitForReview then REVIEW; add tag "media"; publish then PUBLISHED; render exact Hello|Body|a@b.com; assert version history size==1 with Version number==1 and same text; assert TaggingSystem.searchByTag(Arrays.asList(release),"media") returns only that release.

src/main/java/ReleaseState.java:
- public enum ReleaseState { DRAFT, REVIEW, PUBLISHED }
- Sole definition site. Used by PressRelease to represent lifecycle state.

src/main/java/Version.java:
- public final class Version
  - private final int number;
  - private final String renderedText;
  - public Version(int number, String renderedText)
  - public int getNumber()
  - public String getRenderedText()
  - public boolean equals(Object o)
  - public int hashCode()
  - public String toString()
- Semantics: Value object with value-based equality by number and renderedText. Immutable; constructor stores given values without mutation; getters return stored values; toString returns a stable human-readable representation including both fields.

src/main/java/Template.java:
- public final class Template
  - private final String name;
  - private final String content;
  - public Template(String name, String content)
  - public String getName()
  - public String getContent()
  - public String applyCustomFields(java.util.Map<String, String> fields)
- Semantics: Immutable template with deterministic placeholder substitution. The literal placeholder form is {{key}}. applyCustomFields:
  - Treat null fields map as empty.
  - For each entry in fields, replace all literal occurrences of {{key}} in content with value (null values are treated as empty string "").
  - Missing placeholders remain unchanged. No side effects. Deterministic: same inputs produce same outputs.

src/main/java/Validator.java:
- public final class Validator
  - public static boolean validateHeadline(String text)
  - public static boolean validateBody(String text)
  - public static boolean validateContact(String text)
- Semantics: Stateless validation utilities. validateHeadline/validateBody return true iff text is non-null and contains at least one non-whitespace character (trim().isEmpty() == false). validateContact returns true iff text is non-null, contains exactly one '@', and both the local part (before '@') and domain part (after '@') are non-empty after trimming. All methods return false for invalid inputs and never throw.

src/main/java/PressRelease.java:
- public final class PressRelease
  - private final String id, headline, body, contact;
  - private final Template template;
  - private final java.util.LinkedHashMap<String,String> customFields; (defensive copy)
  - private ReleaseState state; (initially DRAFT)
  - private final java.util.LinkedHashSet<String> tags; (insertion ordered, trimmed, unique)
  - private final java.util.List<Version> versionHistory; (insertion ordered)
  - public PressRelease(String id, String headline, String body, String contact, Template template, java.util.Map<String,String> customFields)
  - public String getId()
  - public String getHeadline()
  - public String getBody()
  - public String getContact()
  - public ReleaseState getState()
  - public boolean validate()
  - public void submitForReview()
  - public void publish()
  - public void addTag(String tag)
  - public java.util.List<String> getTags()
  - public String renderPlainText()
  - public java.util.List<Version> getVersionHistory()
- Semantics:
  - Construction: stores provided values; copies customFields into an insertion-ordered LinkedHashMap (null map treated as empty); initializes state to DRAFT; tags empty; versionHistory empty.
  - validate(): returns Validator.validateHeadline(headline) && Validator.validateBody(body) && Validator.validateContact(contact). No side effects.
  - submitForReview(): Requires current state == DRAFT and validate() == true. On success, state transitions to REVIEW. Otherwise throws IllegalStateException.
  - publish(): Requires current state == REVIEW. On success, appends exactly one new Version(1, renderPlainText()) to versionHistory if this is the first publication (i.e., versionHistory is empty) and sets state to PUBLISHED. Any call when not in REVIEW throws IllegalStateException. No randomness/clock involved.
  - addTag(String tag): Ignores null or blank input. Stores trimmed tag. Maintains insertion order and uniqueness (no duplicate entries). No exception for duplicates; duplicates are ignored.
  - getTags(): Returns a defensive copy (java.util.ArrayList) of tags preserving insertion order.
  - renderPlainText(): Builds a new field map with keys "headline", "body", "contact" using the instance fields, then overlays/extends with constructor customFields (constructor fields take effect in addition to the three built-ins; if the map contains these keys, their values will be used by Template substitution rules). Delegates to template.applyCustomFields(map) and returns result. No mutation of internal collections.
  - getVersionHistory(): Returns a defensive copy (java.util.ArrayList) of versions preserving insertion order.
  - Error behavior: submitForReview()/publish() throw IllegalStateException on invalid transitions; other methods avoid throwing for invalid data, except standard NPE if required constructor arguments (like template) are null and dereferenced later by caller; tests rely only on specified behavior.

src/main/java/TaggingSystem.java:
- public final class TaggingSystem
  - public static java.util.List<PressRelease> searchByTag(java.util.List<PressRelease> releases, String tag)
- Semantics: Returns a new list preserving the input order of releases that contain the exact trimmed tag in their getTags() collection. If releases is null or tag is null, returns an empty list. The tag argument is trimmed before matching; matching is exact (case-sensitive). Stateless and deterministic.

src/main/java/RenderService.java:
- public final class RenderService
  - public static String toPlainText(PressRelease release)
- Semantics: Stateless delegator. Returns release.renderPlainText(). If release is null, throws NullPointerException due to dereference; tests do not require special null handling.

src/main/java/Main.java:
- public final class Main
  - public static void main(String[] args)
- Semantics: Thin, non-interactive demo that constructs a Template and a PressRelease with simple values, checks validate(), performs submitForReview() and publish(), renders plain text via RenderService.toPlainText(), prints one or two lines, and exits normally. No input, no loops, no network/filesystem/clock access.

We preserve the protocol: build file pom.xml, runtime entry src/main/java/Main.java, and single test target src/test/java/MainTest.java executed by mvn -q test. We keep every class in the default package (no package declarations) to avoid import mismatches. We use only headless, offline, pure Java 11 logic: no GUI, no filesystem, no network, no clock, no randomness.

Core domain model:
- ReleaseState: sole enum owner of DRAFT, REVIEW, PUBLISHED.
- Version: sole value object owner; number and renderedText with value-based equality, hashCode, getters, toString.
- Template: immutable name+content with deterministic placeholder substitution: literal {{key}} replaced if key is provided in the given Map; missing placeholders remain; null map treated as empty.
- Validator: stateless static methods for headline/body/contact validation. Headline/body require non-null/non-blank. Contact requires exactly one '@' and non-empty local and domain parts.
- PressRelease: aggregate root owning id, headline, body, contact, template, customFields, tags, state, and version history. Starts DRAFT. submitForReview() requires validate()==true and state DRAFT; otherwise IllegalStateException. publish() requires REVIEW; on first publication append exactly one Version(1, renderPlainText()) and move to PUBLISHED. Exposes defensive copies in insertion order for tags and versions. renderPlainText() constructs a new field map of headline, body, contact plus constructor customFields, then delegates to Template.applyCustomFields.
- TaggingSystem: stateless searchByTag(List<PressRelease>, String) that returns releases whose tags contain the exact trimmed tag, preserving input order. Nulls are treated defensively: null list or null tag yields empty result.
- RenderService: stateless toPlainText(PressRelease) delegating to release.renderPlainText; no ownership of ReleaseState or Version.

Maven/JUnit setup: pom.xml declares Java 11 compilation, the org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter dependency with test scope (as mandated) plus api/engine artifacts for runtime, and Maven Surefire 3.x to run JUnit 5. Tests are concise and deterministic.

Concrete implementation tasks by file (dependency-first order):
1) pom.xml: Set groupId/artifactId/version; configure maven-compiler-plugin for Java 11; add org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter with test scope; add junit-jupiter-api and junit-jupiter-engine; configure surefire 3.1.2 to enable JUnit 5.
2) src/main/java/ReleaseState.java: Define exactly public enum ReleaseState { DRAFT, REVIEW, PUBLISHED } as the sole owner.
3) src/main/java/Version.java: Define public final class Version with private final int number; private final String renderedText; public constructor Version(int,String); getters getNumber/getRenderedText; implement equals/hashCode/toString value-based.
4) src/main/java/Template.java: Define public final class Template(name,content) immutable; getters; applyCustomFields(Map<String,String>): if fields is null treat as empty; replace literal {{key}} with provided value (null values treated as empty string), others unchanged; no side effects.
5) src/main/java/Validator.java: Define public final class Validator with exactly static boolean validateHeadline(String), validateBody(String), validateContact(String). Headline/body: non-null and not blank. Contact: non-null, contains exactly one '@', with non-empty trimmed local and domain parts.
6) src/main/java/PressRelease.java: Define public final class PressRelease with constructor PressRelease(String id,String headline,String body,String contact,Template template,Map<String,String> customFields). Internal state: ReleaseState, insertion-ordered LinkedHashSet<String> tags, insertion-ordered List<Version> versionHistory, LinkedHashMap<String,String> customFields copy. Expose getters getId/getHeadline/getBody/getContact/getState; boolean validate(); void submitForReview(); void publish(); void addTag(String) (ignore null/blank; store trimmed; preserve insertion order; avoid duplicates); List<String> getTags() returns defensive copy in insertion order; String renderPlainText(); List<Version> getVersionHistory() returns defensive copy in order. Enforce invalid state transitions with IllegalStateException. On first publish (from REVIEW), append exactly new Version(1, renderPlainText()) and move to PUBLISHED.
7) src/main/java/TaggingSystem.java: Stateless utility with static List<PressRelease> searchByTag(List<PressRelease>, String) that returns a new list preserving input order and matching exact trimmed tag against each release.getTags(). Contains no state.
8) src/main/java/RenderService.java: Stateless utility with static String toPlainText(PressRelease) delegating to release.renderPlainText().
9) src/main/java/Main.java: Thin non-interactive demo that constructs a Template and a PressRelease, exercises validate/submitForReview/publish/render, prints one or two lines, and exits normally.
10) src/test/java/MainTest.java: Exactly three JUnit 5 tests: (1) Main.main(new String[0]) returns normally; (2) Template("basic","{{headline}}|{{body}}|{{contact}}") with fields for headline/body/contact yields Hello|Body|a@b.com; Validator accepts those and rejects blank headline and contact "invalid"; (3) Lifecycle test for release id "r1": assert initial DRAFT; submitForReview then REVIEW; add tag "media"; publish then PUBLISHED; render exact Hello|Body|a@b.com; assert version history size==1 with Version number==1 and same text; assert TaggingSystem.searchByTag(Arrays.asList(release),"media") returns only that release.
